name: Fujian Nanping Sun Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Nanping Sun Cable Co., Ltd. engages in research and manufacturing of wires and cables in China. The company offers aluminum alloy conductor cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cables, mining rubber sheathed flexible cable, control cable, PVC insulated wire, Polyvinyl chloride insulated power cables, cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cables, overhead insulated cable, photovoltaic cable, irradiation cross-linked halogen-free low-smoke flame-retardant polyolefin insulated wire and cable series, metal-sheathed inorganic mineral insulated cables, 220KV cables, and marine cables.
